SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.username, u.real_name AS realName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.email, u.phone, u.mobile, u.gender, u.avatar, u.is_enabled AS isEnabled FROM user u JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.username = u.username AND ur.role_name = 'student'
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{email}, '%')
AND u.gender = #{gender}
AND u.is_enabled = #{isEnabled}
ORDER BY u.id

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.teacher_name AS teacher, NULL AS semester, NULL AS score, NULL AS status, NULL AS selectTime, NULL AS remark FROM course c WHERE c.teacher_name = #{teacherName} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT u.username, u.real_name AS realName, c.name AS courseName, sc.semester, sc.score, sc.status, sc.select_time AS selectTime, sc.remark FROM student_course sc JOIN course c ON c.id = sc.course_id JOIN user u ON u.username = sc.student_name WHERE c.teacher_name = #{teacherName} AND sc.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY sc.id

SELECT sc.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.teacher_name AS teacher, sc.semester, sc.score, sc.status, sc.select_time AS selectTime, sc.remark FROM student_course sc JOIN course c ON c.id = sc.course_id WHERE sc.student_name = #{studentName} ORDER BY sc.course_id
